definitions: The action of sharing something out among a number of recipients.
The way in which something is shared out among a group or spread over an area.
The action or process of supplying goods to stores and other businesses that sell to consumers.
The frequency of occurrence or the extent of existence of something within a given area or group.
A function that gives the probabilities of different possible outcomes for an experiment.
examples: The distribution of food to the needy.
The geographical distribution of the species.
The company's distribution network is extensive.
The distribution of wealth in the country.
